root_causes.description: Cart service experiencing extreme memory pressure with z-score +370.57, accompanied by CPU stress (z=+33.36), latency spike (z=+37.33), and massive pod restarts (z>1000), causing downstream propagation of failures.

remediation_steps: Immediately scale up cart service resources or add additional replicas to alleviate memory pressure
Investigate memory leak in cart service codepath; review recent deployments and code changes around cart functionality
Implement circuit breakers and backpressure in downstream services (checkout, payment) to absorb cart latency spikes
Monitor cart memory and CPU metrics post-remediation to confirm stabilization
